motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Background and console border changes; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: holding-pulse
motion.purpose: Console open holding span during an active run only; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: illustrative-sequence
motion.purpose: Explicitly illustrative playback with Play/Pause and scrub. Reduced motion starts completed; manual play remains available.

motion.name: site-navigation
motion.purpose: Progressive root view transition on overview/judge/live pages only, under no-preference.

components.name: Primary action
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:11px 20px; border:1px solid var(--accent, #50d9f3); border-radius:6px; background:var(--accent, #50d9f3); color:var(--bg, #090e14); font:650 15px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#98eafa; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #50d9f3); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-primary:disabled { background:var(--panel, #101923); color:var(--dim, #8d9bad); border-color:var(--border, #304154); cursor:not-allowed; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview:
Cool charcoal surfaces, ice cyan actions, and clear instrument labels give StutterTurn the character of a working studio. The user selected this direction on 2026-10-10, replacing the earlier warm brown and cream appearance. Controls have visible edges and clear state changes; generous landing-page type introduces the same visual language used in the denser operating console.

This is the shared visual authority for the [overview](index.html), [judge guide](judge/index.html), [live workspace](live/index.html), and [call console](demo-ui/index.html). Its tokens come from [site.css](site.css) and [console styles](demo-ui/styles.css); the [console design document](demo-ui/DESIGN.md) specializes their operating layout and event semantics. [PRODUCT.md](../PRODUCT.md) records product constraints, and the [surface brief](../.impeccable/surfaces/studio-refresh.md) records this refresh's composition. The [root v2 sidecar](../.impeccable/design.json) holds component previews and extensions; its derived tonal ramps are preview aids, not additional production colors.
keyCharacteristics: Cool charcoal layers and cyan controls with visible borders.
Large Archivo headlines balanced by precise JetBrains Mono instrumentation.
Caller, decision, and reported audio remain distinct, labeled tracks.
Responsive controls, keyboard access, and explicit evidence provenance.

rules.name: The Labeled State Rule
rules.body: State color always accompanies text; overlap also has a patterned band. Cyan controls do not imply reported audio.

rules.name: The Two Reading Speeds Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo and body copy to explain the task; use mono type for values that people inspect or compare.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Separate working areas with tone, spacing, and borders; reserve bright color for an action or a labeled state.

dos: **Do** use the shared cool charcoal palette and cyan control hierarchy.
**Do** keep labels, focus, native controls, and horizontal-scroll access intact.
**Do** keep illustration, synthetic preview, and backend evidence visibly distinct.
**Do** keep replay provenance and playback limitations beside the corresponding data.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce the superseded warm brown and cream visual world.
**Don't** turn illustrative proportions into recorded timings or add invented waveforms.
**Don't** use color alone to communicate caller, holding, audio, or overlap state.
**Don't** imply that a turn decision or received audio verifies speaker playback.
